message.subject: AI Design School: 40% OFF, 5 days left 🚀
message.body:
The least popular decision I made this launch — and everything you get anyway.

Hi Sofiene,

 

The most common question since Monday: wait, no refunds?

 

Correct. It's the part of this offer I've thought about hardest.

 

A guarantee sounds generous. For a course, it mostly does one thing → it lets
you buy without deciding. You tell yourself you'll try it. Seven days pass. The
only thing you actually did was give yourself an exit.

 

So I did the opposite. I cut the price by nearly half and asked for one thing
back: that you mean it.

 

Here's what you're committing to:

 

The full 7-step course, three bonus courses, the Builder Pass and lifetime
community → $6,490 value, yours for $129 until Aug 31.

 

If you need a safety net to start, this isn't your moment, and I'd rather you
kept the $129. If you're ready, it's all in there.

Apply to join - $129 ➔ [https://adplist.org/vibe-code-designers]

Felix from ADPList
